description: This file defines the VerifyPickSession class, which manages the verification process during order picking in a warehouse shipment system. It includes methods for creating pick rows, checking inventory reservations, handling shipment creation, issuing items to shipments, and finalizing the verification process. It interacts heavily with the OFBiz entity engine, services, and utility classes to perform its operations.

classes.name: VerifyPickSession
classes.description: Represents a session for verifying picked items in a shipment process. Manages pick rows, inventory validation, shipment creation, and completion workflow.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Creates a new pick verification row based on order and product details, handling inventory reservations.

methods.name: findOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Finds the order item sequence ID for a given product and order based on available reservations.

methods.name: checkRowForAdd
methods.description: Checks whether a reservation can hold a specified quantity and updates or determines the need for a new row.

methods.name: createVerifyPickRow
methods.description: Creates a new VerifyPickSessionRow or updates existing ones based on reservation checks.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the user login information.

methods.name: setFacilityId
methods.description: Sets the facility ID associated with the session.

methods.name: getFacilityId
methods.description: Returns the facility ID.

methods.name: setPicklistBinId
methods.description: Sets the picklist bin ID.

methods.name: getPicklistBinId
methods.description: Returns the picklist bin ID.

methods.name: getPickRows
methods.description: Returns the list of pick rows in the session.

methods.name: getPickRows
methods.description: Filters and returns pick rows for a specific order ID.

methods.name: getReadyToVerifyQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity ready to be verified for a specific order and item.

methods.name: getPickRow
methods.description: Retrieves a specific pick row matching detailed identifiers.

methods.name: getVerifiedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the total verified quantity for specified identifiers.

methods.name: clearAllRows
methods.description: Clears all pick rows from the session.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the verification process by validating quantities, creating shipments, issuing items, and updating products.

methods.name: checkReservedQty
methods.description: Validates that verified quantities match reservations.

methods.name: getReservedQty
methods.description: Retrieves the total reserved quantity for a given order and item.

methods.name: checkVerifiedQty
methods.description: Ensures all order items are fully verified.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues verified items into the shipment.

methods.name: checkLine
methods.description: Determines if a pick row should be processed based on duplication.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on a pick session line.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates product information, such as origin geographic ID.
